description: Series for the prices and flows map: the day-ahead prices (Energy Prices 12.1.D, A44, day-ahead auction) of the Italian bidding zones ('ZONE|day_ahead'), EUR/MWh; the imbalance prices (17.1.G, A85) of the neighbouring control areas ('AREA|imbalance': excess balance price, A04, the insufficient balance price filling its gaps; 'AREA|imbalance_short': the insufficient balance price, A05, where an area publishes two), EUR/MWh; the neighbours' generation ('AREA|generation': Actual Generation per Production Type 16.1.B&C, A75, the types summed) and load ('AREA|load': Actual Total Load 6.1.A&B, A65), MW. Hourly = average of the quarter-hours; daily = average of the hours. Italian market time (Europe/Rome), labelled by elapsed time since local midnight like GME periods. Quarter-hourly series start at quarter_hourly_native_from; earlier quarter-hours repeat the hourly value. ENTSO-E publishes the Italian zones' negative day-ahead prices without their sign: sign_restored lists the quarter-hours ({series: {date: [times]}}) given back their minus sign, where JAO's day-ahead spread with a neighbour (North: Austria, France, Slovenia; South: Greece) and the neighbour's day-ahead price give the zone's price, and in the neighbouring zones at the same published price.
